full_prompt_en: A square finely detailed watercolor depicts a quiet village cottage beside a small pond under a tall old tree. The sky is an open, warm cream wash with little cloud detail, allowing the dense branching canopy to dominate the upper middle. Beyond the tree, softer blue-gray foliage fades into the distance. On the left, a pale plaster cottage has a steep golden thatched roof, red-brown chimneys, small dark windows, and climbing greenery close to its doorway. A low adjoining outbuilding sits under the central tree, partly hidden by its foliage. The tree trunk rises through the middle of the composition; hundreds of tiny irregular leaf marks make the canopy airy at its edge and deeper olive in its center. A light dirt track curves from the lower foreground toward the cottage and then runs past a few very small figures near the tree. Grasses and bushes border the route in muted yellow-green and brown. The pond occupies the lower right, its dark green-blue surface carrying pale sky reflections and a slightly broken shore. Thin drawing lines define roof edges, branches, windows, and reeds, while transparent washes keep walls, path, and sky light. Daylight is soft and warm from the open sky, with darker shade concentrated beneath the canopy and along the near bank. The meandering path and water draw the eye through nested clusters of architecture and foliage. Fine botanical detail against broad pale spaces gives this modest rural scene a calm, storybook clarity.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形精细水彩描绘安静的村庄小屋，旁边是小池塘，上方有一棵高大的老树。天空是一片温暖的奶油色淡洗，几乎没有云的细节，使密集枝冠主导上方中央。树后更柔和的蓝灰枝叶逐渐退远。左侧一座浅色灰泥小屋有陡峭的金黄茅草屋顶、红褐色烟囱、小深窗，以及靠近门边的攀缘植物。一座低矮附屋位于中央树下，部分被叶片遮住。树干从画面中部升起，数百个不规则小叶痕使树冠外缘通透、中心呈更深的橄榄色。一条浅色土路从下方前景弯向小屋，然后经过树边几个极小的人影。柔暗黄绿与褐色的草和灌木沿路生长。池塘占据右下，深绿蓝水面带浅色天空倒影，岸线略为破碎。细描线限定屋顶边缘、枝条、窗户与芦草，透明洗色则让墙、路和天空保持轻盈。日光从开阔天空柔和温暖地照来，较深阴影集中在树冠下和近岸。蜿蜒土路与池水带领目光穿过层层建筑和植物。细密植物细节与宽阔浅色空间相对，让朴素乡景显得平静而清楚，带着绘本气息。
style_prompt_en: Delicate narrative watercolor sets thin descriptive lines within pale transparent washes. Cream, straw yellow, olive, and muted blue-gray remain low in saturation, with small red-brown accents and dark green pockets adding structure. Leafy masses gain density through many tiny irregular touches, but their outer edges stay broken and airy. Broad lightly washed intervals keep the fine drawing from becoming crowded. Soft daylight is spread through the scene, while shade collects beneath overlapping forms and in the nearest recesses. A curved visual route links foreground, middle detail, and softly receding background. The whole treatment balances precise miniature observation, paper-like lightness, and a gently ordered rural rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 细腻的叙事水彩在浅淡透明洗染中加入纤细描述线。奶油、麦秆黄、橄榄和柔暗蓝灰保持低饱和，少量红褐点缀和深绿内凹区域提供结构。叶片体块由大量细小不规则点触逐渐变密，外缘却保持破碎通透。宽阔浅洗区使精细描绘不至于拥挤。柔和日光铺过画面，阴影聚在重叠形体下与近处凹处。弯曲的视觉路线连接前景、中景细节和柔化的远景。整体处理平衡了微型观察的精确、纸面般的轻盈，以及温和有序的乡野节奏。
theme_en: A thatched cottage beneath an old tree beside a village pond
theme_zh: 古树下的茅顶小屋与村边池塘
name: 细线田园水彩叙事
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
